messages:
jamie: Heads up — planning to deploy inference-runtime v1.9.2 tonight 02:00 UTC (maintenance window 02:00–03:30). This is config + tokenizer patch, no DB migrations. Need smoke owners + quick signoffs.
sarah: I can own smoke. Which checks do you want me to run? :white_check_mark:
jamie: thanks. Primary smoke checklist:
- verify /health + /metrics
- run embed similarity spot-check against control set
- check 95p and p99 latency via grafana link
- verify model-serving logs for KV cache errors
Also want canary on 10% traffic for 15m, then ramp if green.
devon: rollback plan? if anything spikes, do we have easy fallback?
jamie: yes — toggle routing to stable pool (route flag) and revert inference image to v1.9.1. Rollback steps in ops runbook.
miguel: I can run the canary and watch infra metrics. Will notify if errors > 0.5% or latency > +30% vs baseline.
olivia: Do we need product signoff for behaviour change? tokenizer tweak might affect tokenization of prompts.
jamie: product aware; they asked for a small tokenization fix. They've approved but want a sample evaluation run after canary. @sarah pls run eval set when canary is live.
sarah: ack. I'll run the eval and post summary. Quick Q: where's the smoke script? repo or console?
jamie: smoke script in infra/tools/deploy-smoke.sh — snippet below:
```bash
# run from CI runner
./infra/tools/deploy-smoke.sh --env=staging --sample=100 --check=latency,errors,similarity
```
sarah: got it. I'll use that and paste results here.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment for inference-runtime v1.9.2 at 1769808000 (02:00 UTC). Canary traffic = 10% for 15m, auto-ramp = true. :robot_face:
miguel: quick note — enabling continuous batching config can cause latency variance for short requests. I'll keep an eye on p50/p95.
jamie: good call. If batching causes >10% p95 degradation for short queries, treat as failure and rollback.
-- 02:15 UTC (canary) --
sarah: smoke run complete: health ok, /metrics: no 5xx, p95 +5% (within threshold), embeddings similarity delta mean=0.002 (control ~0.0018). Logs: no KV cache errors. Posting full gist: https://gist.github.com/abcd1234
miguel: infra metrics look stable. error rate 0.08% (baseline 0.05%), cpu on canary nodes +6%. all within thresholds.
devon: approving rollout based on canary. :thumbsup:
jamie: product confirmed via DM, evaluation run passed for top-100 prompts.
-- 02:35 UTC (ramping) --
sarah: smoke complete for rollout. all checks green. I sign off for production ramp. ✅
jamie: thanks all. final checklist before full ramp:
- [x] smoke owner assigned (sarah)
- [x] canary complete (miguel)
- [x] product eval passed (olivia)
- [x] rollback plan documented (jamie)
- [x] deploy-bot scheduled (deploy-bot)
jamie: proceeding to full rollout now. I'll post a short postmortem if anything unexpected shows up.
miguel: watching. ping me if we need immediate rollback.
sarah: noted. closing thread once we reach steady-state 10m.
-- 02:45 UTC --
jamie: full rollout complete, metrics steady. closing. :tada:
